svg.title: Bridge request lifecycle
svg.desc: Lifecycle of one bridge request shared by advise, review and implement in both directions: entry, selection, authority gates, peer launch, result envelope and detached job controls
svg.text: advise · review · implement in both directions, plus detached-job controls — one peer child per request, no fan
unlabeled arrow = block finished, next block starts · pills name every condition
ONE REQUEST, FROM ENTRY TO ENVELOPE

g.text: levels: minimal → max (max on request only)
network: none · github-read, Codex peer only

svg.text: BRANCH · all gates passed, exactly one path runs

g.text: foreground: JSON on stdout / MCP result
detached: stored in the job record

svg.text: DETACHED JOB CONTROLS · CLAUDE SKILLS ONLY

text.tspan: one check per reason, no loop

svg.text: JOB STATES · WHAT THE CONTROLS READ AND WRITE

g.text: Where a request stops before any peer runs
What each job state tells the caller
report error · may have edited files
no result · edit only after peer ends or cutoff
What the picture does not promise
detached moves the child, adds none

text.tspan: implement never retries · edits may land

svg.text: Non-normative lifecycle of one bridge request. The shipped source wins on any disagreement:
claude-skills/*/SKILL.md, codex-skills/*/SKILL.md, bin/bridge_call.py, bin/bridge_mcp.py, docs/operations.md, schemas/.
Update this file in the same commit that changes a verb, gate, budget, retry, envelope field or job state it shows.
